+import numpy as np, yaml
+from fraud_preproc.scalers import load_scaler
+
+PRE_TRANSFORMS = {"none": lambda s: s, "log1p": np.log1p}
+
+class ScalerRegistry:
+    def __init__(self, cfg):
+        self.cfg = cfg
+        self.scalers = {k: load_scaler(v["artifact"]) for k, v in cfg.items()}
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_config(cls, path):
+        return cls(yaml.safe_load(open(path))["scalers"])
+
+    def apply(self, name, df):
+        c = self.cfg[name]
+        col = df[c["column"]]
+        if "clip_max" in c:
+            col = col.clip(upper=c["clip_max"])
+        col = PRE_TRANSFORMS[c.get("pre_transform", "none")](col)
+        return self.scalers[name].transform(col.to_frame()).ravel()
